To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the classical view of top management as the only authority of strategy making is not applicable to the institution under investigation and that organizational culture plays an essential role for strategy as practice.
the strategy practices in the institution are influenced by top management’s strategy sense-giving practices, organizational culture and the staff members’ involvement in implementation.
strategy as practice is influenced by the type of organizational culture, and top management is the key actor in shaping the organizational culture.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of organizational culture in strategy practices of higher education institutions in the context of western Balkans and eastern European countries.
the relationship between top management and staff members in strategy as practice in the higher education sector.
the question of how organizational members make sense of and give sense to their strategy practices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the classical view of top management as a sole authority in strategy making holds only true to a certain extent in the institution under study.
the strategy as a practice is not a sole property of the top management, but it is a collective process that is shared among the members of the institution.

the classical view of the strategy making process is still valid in the institution, however, a shift in strategy making practices is needed in order to attract new students to the institution and retain elite staff members in the organization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
strategy as a practice in higher education institutions should be a collective effort of top management and staff members.
the institution’s strategy practices are shaped by its organizational culture and top management’s sense-making and sense giving practices.
the study contributes to strategy as practice literature in the context of higher education institutions in eastern Europe and western Balkans.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the organizational culture of higher education institutions should be a subject for research and practice.
organizational culture is a key factor in shaping strategy practice.
organizational culture is an important factor for strategy practices in a higher education institution.
